snippet.title: SuperCitycon | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
SuperCitycon carries the spirit of classic city building into a crisp, modern 3D world with a distinctive, retro-inspired 16-bit palette. Raise hills, carve rivers and coastlines, connect your districts with roads, railways, bridges and tunnels, and watch traffic, trains and people bring the streets to life. Then walk through them yourself in first or third person.

Build freely in the sandbox, or start a city in tycoon mode, where an economy runs alongside you without holding you back. A full simulation that will challenge you is in the works, and SuperCitycon is growing into an open platform with more game modes to come.

On PC and Mac, SCC Studio puts the game's own asset pipeline in your hands. Change any building, vehicle or character, or build your own from an empty grid.

🏙 Wishlist SuperCitycon on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474890/
🌐 https://supercitycon.net

#SuperCitycon #CityBuilder #IndieGame
